title: Recall: Move ownership into and out of a function
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

copy.clue: Given original: String, write the expression calling its Clone method to create independent owned text.

move.clue: Given fn decorate(String) -> String and original: String, write the call transferring original into decorate.
